options.query:
SELECT r.run_id, r.started_at, r.ended_at, r.status, r.branch, r.commit, r.build_url,
       r.machine, r.browser, r.browser_version, r.cypress_version, r.total_specs,
       r.total_tests, r.passed, r.failed, r.pending, r.skipped, r.duration_ms,
       r.last_event_at, r.pr, r.triggered_by, rp.project_id
FROM clr_runs r
JOIN clr_run_project rp USING (run_id)
WHERE CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(NULLIF('{{variables.selectedRunId}}', ''), 'undefined') IS NOT NULL
          THEN r.run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{variables.selectedRunId}}', ''), 'undefined')::uuid
        ELSE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
               NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
               (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
                GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
      END
ORDER BY (r.status = 'running') DESC, r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO clr_projects (project_id, name, repo_url, color, archived)
VALUES (lower(trim(:pid)), trim(:pname), NULLIF(trim(:prepo), ''), :pcolor, :parch)
ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE
  SET name = EXCLUDED.name, repo_url = EXCLUDED.repo_url, color = EXCLUDED.color, archived = EXCLUDED.archived
RETURNING project_id

INSERT INTO clr_run_projects (run_id, project_id)
VALUES (NULLIF(:rid,'')::uuid, :pid)
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET project_id = EXCLUDED.project_id
RETURNING run_id

SELECT r.run_id::text AS run_id, r.status, r.started_at, r.machine, r.browser,
       r.total_tests, r.total_specs, rp.project_id
FROM clr_runs r
JOIN clr_run_project rp USING (run_id)
WHERE rp.project_id = 'unassigned'
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT test_id, title, spec,
       split_part(spec, '/', array_length(string_to_array(spec,'/'),1)) AS spec_file,
       state, attempt, duration_ms, error, updated_at
FROM clr_tests_live
WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid
ORDER BY (state = 'running') DESC, (state = 'failed') DESC, updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.run_id, rp.project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.color,
       r.status, r.started_at, r.duration_ms, r.total_tests, r.passed, r.failed,
       r.browser, r.machine
FROM clr_runs r
JOIN clr_run_project rp USING (run_id)
JOIN clr_projects p ON p.project_id = rp.project_id
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT t.run_id::text AS run_id, t.state, t.attempt, t.duration_ms, t.error,
       r.started_at, to_char(r.started_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS run_label, r.status AS run_status
FROM clr_tests_live t
JOIN clr_runs r USING (run_id)
WHERE t.test_id = '{{components.flakyTable.selectedRow.test_id}}'
ORDER BY r.started_at
LIMIT 200

SELECT spec,
       split_part(spec, '/', array_length(string_to_array(spec,'/'),1)) AS spec_file,
       status, duration_ms, passes, failures, pending, skipped, planned_tests, updated_at, video
FROM clr_specs
WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid
ORDER BY (status = 'failed') DESC, updated_at
LIMIT 500

SELECT t.test_id, t.spec,
       split_part(t.spec,'/', array_length(string_to_array(t.spec,'/'),1)) AS spec_file,
       count(*) AS total_runs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'passed') AS passed_runs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'failed') AS failed_runs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'passed' AND t.attempt > 1) AS retry_passes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'failed') / count(*), 1) AS fail_rate_pct,
       max(t.updated_at) AS last_seen
FROM clr_tests_live t
JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
        (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
         GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
GROUP BY t.test_id, t.spec
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'passed') > 0
   AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'failed') > 0
ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC, total_runs DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(planned_tests),0) FROM clr_specs WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid) AS planned,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND state IN ('passed','failed')) AS completed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND state = 'passed') AS passed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND state = 'failed') AS failed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND state = 'running') AS running,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND attempt > 1) AS retried,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_specs WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid) AS spec_count,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_specs WHERE run_id = NULLIF(NULLIF('{{queries.getLiveRun.data[0].run_id}}',''),'undefined')::uuid AND status = 'failed') AS spec_failed
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.run_id::text AS run_id, t.test_id, t.title, t.spec,
       split_part(t.spec,'/', array_length(string_to_array(t.spec,'/'),1)) AS spec_file,
       t.attempt, t.duration_ms, t.updated_at
FROM clr_tests_live t
JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
        (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
         GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
  AND t.state = 'passed' AND t.attempt > 1
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT t.test_id, t.run_id::text AS run_id, t.state, t.attempt, t.duration_ms,
       to_char(r.started_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS run_label, r.started_at, t.error
FROM clr_tests_live t
JOIN clr_runs r USING (run_id)
JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
        (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
         GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
ORDER BY t.test_id, r.started_at
LIMIT 1000

SELECT t.test_id,
       split_part(t.spec,'/', array_length(string_to_array(t.spec,'/'),1)) AS spec_file,
       round(avg(t.duration_ms))::bigint AS avg_ms,
       max(t.duration_ms) AS max_ms,
       count(*) AS runs
FROM clr_tests_live t
JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
        (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
         GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
  AND t.duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.test_id, t.spec
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT label, passed, failed, duration_s FROM (
  SELECT to_char(r.started_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS label,
         COALESCE(r.passed,0) AS passed,
         COALESCE(r.failed,0) AS failed,
         round(COALESCE(r.duration_ms,0) / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_s,
         r.started_at
  FROM clr_runs r
  JOIN clr_run_project rp USING (run_id)
  WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
          NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
          (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
           GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 20) t
ORDER BY started_at
LIMIT 20

SELECT p.project_id, p.name, p.color,
       count(r.run_id) AS total_runs,
       count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'running') AS running_now,
       count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'passed') AS passed_runs,
       count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed') AS failed_runs,
       max(r.started_at) AS last_run_at,
       round(100.0 * count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'passed')
             / NULLIF(count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('passed','failed')), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct
FROM clr_projects p
LEFT JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN clr_runs r ON r.run_id = rp.run_id
WHERE p.archived = false
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.name, p.color
ORDER BY running_now DESC, last_run_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

SELECT r.run_id, r.status, r.started_at, r.ended_at, r.duration_ms, r.total_tests,
       r.passed, r.failed, r.pending, r.skipped, r.browser, r.browser_version,
       r.machine, r.branch, r.commit, r.pr, r.cypress_version, r.total_specs,
       round(100.0 * COALESCE(r.passed,0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(r.total_tests,0),0), 0) AS pass_pct
FROM clr_runs r
JOIN clr_run_project rp USING (run_id)
WHERE rp.project_id = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{components.projectSelect.value}}', ''), 'undefined'), 'null'),
        (SELECT rp2.project_id FROM clr_run_project rp2 JOIN clr_runs r2 USING (run_id)
         GROUP BY rp2.project_id ORDER BY max(r2.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1))
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_runs) AS total_runs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_runs WHERE status = 'running') AS active_runs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_runs WHERE status = 'stale') AS stale_runs,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT test_id) FROM clr_tests_live) AS distinct_tests,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_tests_live WHERE state = 'passed' AND attempt > 1) AS retry_flakes,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT test_id FROM clr_tests_live GROUP BY test_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='passed') > 0 AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='failed') > 0) f) AS flaky_tests,
  (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='passed') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('passed','failed')),0), 1) FROM clr_runs) AS pass_rate_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clr_projects WHERE archived = false) AS project_count
LIMIT 1

SELECT type, ts, attempt, name, screenshot_base64, artifact_url, page_url,
       steps_before_failure, command, width, height, commands, total_commands,
       asserts, console_logs, total_logs, stdout, error
FROM clr_artifacts
WHERE run_id = NULLIF(:rid,'')::uuid
  AND test_id = :tid
ORDER BY seq
LIMIT 20

SELECT p.project_id, p.name, p.color, p.repo_url, p.archived,
       count(r.run_id) AS total_runs,
       count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'passed') AS passed_runs,
       count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed') AS failed_runs,
       max(r.started_at) AS last_run_at,
       round(100.0 * count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'passed')
             / NULLIF(count(r.run_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('passed','failed')), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct
FROM clr_projects p
LEFT JOIN clr_run_project rp ON rp.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN clr_runs r ON r.run_id = rp.run_id
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.name, p.color, p.repo_url, p.archived
ORDER BY p.archived, last_run_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200
